Farah stands beside her, one hand on desk and one relaxed small palm-up gesture about the cost of missed anomalies. Both visible faces and propercanonicalbodies. Do not label the other two as confirmed anomalies, source doesn't establish that here. No Gaussian, random lights or invented measured rates.
